text: Call Issued: January 27, 2017 Call Closed: March 17, 2017 Number of Addenda Issued: Not Applicable Number of Bids: Five (5)

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (June 11, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: Vendor of Record No. OSS-00634452 Description: For the Supply and Delivery of Seven (7) Various Light Duty Vehicles in 2018 with option to purchase Twenty-Seven (27) units in 2019, Seventy (70) units in 2020, Seventy-Two (72) units in 2021 and Sixty-Five (105) units in 2022, pending budget availability. If the contract is extended for a sixth year (at the discretion of the Ministry of Government and Consumer Services), Fleet Services may purchase Seventy-Seven (77) units in 2023.
